hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: By the Lord of this House (Ka'bah), whoever is reached by the morning while in a state of janabah (ritual impurity), then let him break his fast. [This was Abu Hurayrah's initial understanding which was later corrected]

hadiths.arabicText:
عَنِ /94 ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ /94 ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي /26 عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ /26 ، أَنَّ /26 يَحْيَى بْنَ جَعْدَةَ /26 أَخْبَرَهُ ، عَنْ /26 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ /26 ، أَنَّهُ /27 سَمِعَ /93 أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، يَقُولُ : وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ ، /20 مَنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الصُّبْحُ جُنُبًا    @ 4 : 181 @   فَلْيُفْطِرْ /27 ، وَلَكِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ " * 
$7203  7205 /3

hadiths.english_translation: 'Ata' was asked: Should a man spend the night in state of janabah in Ramadan until morning deliberately, then fast? He said: As for Abu Hurayrah, he used to forbid that, but as for 'Aishah, she used to say there is no harm in that. When they differed before 'Ata', he said: Let him complete that day and make up another day.

عَنْ /94 مَعْمَرٍ /94 ، عَنْ /26 أَيُّوبَ /26 ، عَنِ /26 ابْنِ سِيرِينَ /26 ، /27 أَنَّ /93 ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ L5079 /93 ، قَالَ : /20 مَا أُبَالِي أَنْ أُصِيبَ امْرَأَتِي ثُمَّ أُصْبِحُ جُنُبًا ثُمَّ أَصُومُ ، أَتَيْتُ حَلالا " /27 * 
$7205  7207 /3

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: A man from the neighborhood came to me and said: I passed by my wife in the moonlight and she impressed me, so I had intercourse with her in Ramadan, then I slept until I woke up (still in janabah). I said to him: Go to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud or to Abu Hakim al-Muzani. So he went to Abdullah and asked him. He said: You were in janabah not permissible for you to pray, then you performed ghusl and prayer became permissible for you, and fasting became permissible for you, so fast.

hadiths.arabicText:
عَنِ /94 الثَّوْرِيِّ /94 ، عَنْ /26 جَامِعِ بْنِ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ /26 ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا /26 عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مِرْدَاسٍ /26 ، قَالَ : /27 جَاءَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْحَيِّ ، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي مَرَرْتُ بِامْرَأَتِي فِي الْقَمَرِ فَأَعْجَبَتْنِي ، فَجَامَعْتُهَا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ، فَنِمْتُ حَتَّى أَصْبَحْتُ ، فَقُلْتُ : عَلَيْكَ /93 بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ /93 ، أَوْ بِأَبِي حَكِيمٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ ، فَأَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلَهُ ، فَقَالَ : /20 كُنْتَ جُنُبًا لا تَحِلُّ لَكَ الصَّلاةُ ، فَاغْتَسَلْتَ فَحَلَّتْ لَكَ الصَّلاةُ ، وَحَلَّ لَكَ الصِّيَامُ فَصُمْ " /27 * 
$7206  7208 /3

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: A man came to Abu al-Darda' and said: I had intercourse with my wife, then sleep overcame me until I woke up, and I intended to fast. Abu al-Darda' said: You came to your wife while she is lawful for you, then you were overcome regarding yourself, then Allah returned your consciousness to you. So you prayed when you regained consciousness, and you fasted when you regained consciousness.

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyib: 'Umar ibn al-Khattab used to forbid kissing for the fasting person. It was said to him: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting. He said: 'Who has the self-control and protection that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had?' | Narrated from Ibn 'Abbas: The Prophet ﷺ used to kiss while fasting. | Narrated from 'Aishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss some of his wives while fasting.
